001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import java.util.Random;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhost;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBGoInDirection;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.WeightedRandomPicker;
010
011public class AbyssalDrifterGhost extends BaseSensorGhost {
012
013        public AbyssalDrifterGhost(SensorGhostManager manager, CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
014                super(manager, 0);
015                
016                Random random = manager.getRandom();
017                float r = random.nextFloat();
018                if (r < 0.25f) {
019                        initEntity(genSmallSensorProfile(), genSmallRadius());
020                        if (random.nextFloat() < 0.5f) {
021                                setNumSensorIndicators(2, 3, random);
022                        }
023                } else if (r < 0.6f) {
024                        initEntity(genMediumSensorProfile(), genMediumRadius());
025                        if (random.nextFloat() < 0.5f) {
026                                setNumSensorIndicators(2, 3, random);
027                        }
028                } else {
029                        initEntity(genLargeSensorProfile(), genLargeRadius());
030                        if (random.nextFloat() < 0.5f) {
031                                setNumSensorIndicators(5, 7, random);
032                        }
033                }
034                
035                
036                if (!placeNearPlayer(800, 1200)) {
037                        setCreationFailed();
038                        return;
039                }
040                
041                setDespawnRange(0f);
042                
043                WeightedRandomPicker<Integer> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<Integer>(random);
044                picker.add(0, 15f);
045                picker.add(1, 50f);
046                picker.add(2, 25f);
047                picker.add(3, 10f);
048                
049                int burn = picker.pick();
050                float dur = 15f + random.nextFloat() * 20f;
051                float dir = random.nextFloat() * 360f;
052                
053                addBehavior(new GBGoInDirection(dur, dir, burn));
054        }
055        
056}
057
